natural_caes24_minus_lfp4_usd_kw_year.definition: Relative EFC service valuation of the 24 h A-CAES portfolio versus the additional 4 h LFP portfolio.

efc_value.definition: Relative EFC service valuation of the 24 h A-CAES portfolio versus the additional 4 h LFP portfolio.

system_cost_value.definition: Optimized cost of the additional 4 h LFP portfolio minus that of the 24 h A-CAES portfolio, on the same dispatches.

incremental_efc_credit.definition: Firm-capacity service rate times A-CAES-minus-LFP portfolio EFC, normalized by tail discharge power.

avoided_residual_peak_credit.definition: Firm-capacity service rate times LFP-minus-A-CAES residual peak power, normalized by tail discharge power.
